method: Judgmental mixture: 50% unchanged Phase 3 Beta prior; 50% family mixture of Beta(1+s,1+n-s) proxy posteriors transformed by an assumed +1 frontier log-odds shift. Family weights Kimi .50, GLM .35, DeepSeek .15. A family with no uncensored result contributes its weight back to the Phase 3 prior. Families are alternative predictors, not multiplied independent observations.
assumption_status: Inferred; neither mixture weights nor ability shift are empirically calibrated. These were chosen during the development panel after the first three type-checker outcomes, before the remaining outcomes. Original priors predate the panel. Sensitivity shifts 0 and 2 are also reported. Mechanism review can contradict these assumptions and must be discussed.
confidence_explanation: Low: small valid denominators, informative censoring, shared scaffold, no same-task target anchors, and unknown target scaffold. Distribution spread is deliberate; rounded K is only a shorthand.

typecheck-soundness-witness.label: inferred, judgmental forecast conditional on validity
typecheck-soundness-witness.rationale: The 15-minute generator found no witness, but all three proxy families produce structured accepted programs with concrete type errors. This refutes a strong extrapolation from the negative baseline. Small valid denominators and informative censors leave uncertainty; the assumed stronger target shifts the forecast upward.

exact-fused-dot.label: inferred, judgmental forecast conditional on validity
exact-fused-dot.rationale: All three uncensored trials pass, from DeepSeek alone. Every Kimi/GLM attempt is budget-censored, often after extensive correct-looking work and self-test repairs. The first-place ranking therefore reflects missing outcomes and retained prior uncertainty, not demonstrated hardness. Numerical edge bookkeeping remains plausible, but unconfirmed.

mixed-width-tso.label: inferred, judgmental forecast conditional on validity
mixed-width-tso.rationale: Nine uncensored attempts pass, including complete state exploration across all three families. A recovered exchange-transition bug shows real work, not a persistent limitation. The two harness interruptions are excluded. The finite bounds and repeated success support a high target pass forecast.

checkpointed-journal.label: inferred, judgmental forecast conditional on validity
checkpointed-journal.rationale: All eleven attempts pass across three families. Most intermediate disagreements are repaired auxiliary expectations rather than replay errors. This strongly weakens the proposed lifecycle-state mechanism in this scaffold and supports an easy-control forecast, while small samples and target-scaffold uncertainty prevent certainty.

atomic-range-history.label: inferred, judgmental forecast conditional on validity
atomic-range-history.rationale: Three uncensored attempts pass; eight are censored. Several interrupted agents already use exhaustive search and recover pruning or representation errors. Ten transactions make search feasible. The low-relevance historical control anchor supplies little quantitative information; the high-success prior remains an assumption.

interpretation: No task has an observed uncensored proxy failure. Exact-fused-dot ranks first largely because of prior uncertainty and missing strong-family outcomes. The top two probabilities and the three controls are too close for a robust ranking. No probability of at least one hard task is computed under an unjustified independence assumption.
